profile.headline: Software Developer at LLNL
profile.summary:
I am a relatively new software developer at LLNL, deepening my understanding of the tools of the trade, while adding my efforts to the software repository that will make a positive difference in people's lives. I feel that I have only begun to explore the possibilities of what I can do and become at LLNL, and I am learning a lot as I go.   

I enjoy living in the Bay Area, with all the things to see, eat, and do.

In combination with my engineering background and my language skills, I would like to utilize my passion for graphic novels and artistic sense for projects that bring happiness to the world.

positions.title: Digital Co-Op
positions.description:
-	Tested mobile site launch with usability testing
-       Edited video clips of user testing insights
-       Maintained code and documentation for web apps that I made with Google Apps Script.
-       Learned about A/B testing and Agile practices

positions.title: Information Technology Co-op
positions.description:
-	Created integrated web tools with Google Apps Script in Google Docs. This included projects such as custom mail automation scripts, one of which was used by global employees when they would apply for a corporate credit card with their managers’ approval.

-	Actively participated in the Google Apps Script feedback forum to give detailed bug reports.

positions.title: Chief Assistant
positions.description:
-	Tutored students ages 4 to 15 in Math and Reading. Explained a variety of topics ranging from mastering the letter sounds of the alphabet to high school algebra

-	Collaborated with co-workers on adapting different approaches and creating new teaching materials to supplement the learning experience for struggling students

-	Liaison between instructors and parents, as well as between instructors and assistants 

-	Gained insight about the importance of parent involvement in children’s education, as well as an appreciation for contributions to the whole by people with different temperaments and skill sets

company.name: Kumon Math and Reading Center of Grayslake

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Worked full-time in an office that primarily dealt with international bond trades. Learned more about the world of finance, bonds, and the impact of new data announcements on the economy.

honors.title: Scholarships and Honors
honors.description:
MU Ignatius Scholarship
Dr. J Niederjohn Scholarship

volunteerExperiences.description: OASES is a non-profit organization that provides after-school tutoring for low income students in the Oakland Chinatown area.  I tutored a trio of elementary school students for two semesters on math and reading.
